exposure_audit: All six-arm decoy identities, slots, execution target, visible forwarding, actual triggering, rejected calls, recovery calls and final states are independently replayed.
features: Public destination per first 16 calls, destination totals, first 16 uplink/downlink cipher-byte totals, total calls and bytes. Fixed shape, no plaintext/task IDs/arms.
intervals: 10000 paired stratified-by-action fixture bootstrap draws, fixed seed 102; conditional on fitted attacks and this workload; no population or training-selection uncertainty claim.
primary_attack: Select LR or RF per model/condition by validation balanced accuracy, tie LR. Fit on training only; never use test for selection. Also report both individual attacks, a baseline-selected frozen attack, and position rules.
privacy_endpoint: Six-class balanced accuracy on all terminal held-out tasks, including failed business executions.
privacy_family: 12 paired comparisons: five arms minus none plus isolated_visible minus isolated, separately for each of two models; two-sided exact discordant-pair test, Holm across all 12.
source_status: Retain original PR replay as reference-program evidence, not LLM outcomes; constructed adverse writes are not a WRA evaluation.
unknowns: Report nominal/terminal/unknown and complete-pair denominators for each comparison. No imputation.
utility_endpoints: Requested goal achieved in final state with required checks satisfied
Full final business state equals single intended-action reference state
utility_families: Same 12 paired contrasts for each utility endpoint, separately Holm corrected.
